the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The extension morphism U' to U equals Spec(k') to Spec(k), hence is affine, surjective and flat. The morphisms s, t : R to U and U' to U are universally open by Morphisms, scheme-over-field-universally-open. Since R is not empty and U is the spectrum of a field, s and t are surjective and flat. The asserted properties of every arrow of the defining diagram then follow by the base change and composition lemmas for surjectivity, affineness and open morphisms, and the base change and composition lemmas for flatness; the dotted arrow R' to R is a base change of the affine morphism U' to U, so it is affine as well. (source lines 1241-1255)
